requirements.requirement: The system must execute unit tests that validate prescription schema compliance against defined MongoDB contract for valid sample records.
The system must fail unit tests when required schema fields (e.g., NPI, drug identifier, claim count) are missing or incorrectly typed.
The system must execute ingestion pipeline tests that confirm raw CMS data is successfully fetched and parsed into intermediate structures.
The system must validate that transformation logic correctly maps prescriber records to valid NPI values using test fixtures.
The system must validate that drug-to-condition mappings produced by ICD10 loader are accurate for known test cases.
The system must execute integration tests that confirm transformed prescription records are persisted to MongoDB PublicHealthData.prescriptions collection.
The system must validate that MongoDB persistence maintains idempotency by ensuring duplicate ingestion runs do not create duplicate records.
The system must validate batching behavior by confirming multiple records are written in expected batch sizes during persistence tests.
The system must integrate with existing SIT runner (gpt_sit_runner.py) to execute end-to-end ingestion test scenarios.
The system must produce deterministic test results given the same input dataset across multiple test runs.
The system must fail integration tests when MongoDB connection is unavailable or write operations throw exceptions.
The system must fail ingestion tests when upstream data fetch returns empty or malformed datasets.
The system must log test execution results, including pass/fail status and error messages, consistent with existing pipeline test patterns.
The system must ensure test coverage includes schema validation, ingestion logic, transformation accuracy, and persistence layers.
